title: Ship your goods
intro: You already have the goods: tell us where to collect them, where to deliver them and what you know about the load. We reply with a detailed quote, or with the questions still open.
signedOut: A free account is needed to send a request: it tells us who's asking and lets us reply.
failed: Couldn't send. Try again in a moment.
staff: You're signed in with a staff account: use a customer account to send a request.
fromHint: The pickup address, not necessarily yours.

cargo.title: The load
cargo.hint: Fill in what you know. What's missing we'll ask or measure at pickup; the quote stays provisional until then.
cargo.hard: This date is a hard deadline
cargo.regulated: These goods are regulated: we check they can be shipped and imported before we send you a quote.

customs.title: Customs

CUSTOMER_HANDLES.label: I'll handle it
CUSTOMER_HANDLES.hint: No customs coordination fee from us.

TRACECART_COORDINATES.label: TraceCart handles it
TRACECART_COORDINATES.hint: We coordinate with a broker; duties and taxes are passed on to you as they are.

ALREADY_CLEARED.label: It's already cleared
ALREADY_CLEARED.hint: We may ask for proof of clearance.

UNKNOWN.label: I'm not sure
UNKNOWN.hint: We'll talk it through with you.

customs.documentsHint: E.g. invoice, packing list, certificate. Don't send them now.

reply.title: Our reply
reply.body: We'll reply to {email} and the number below.

disclaimer: A person from the team replies with a quote. Nothing is committed until you agree to it.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: We'll come back to you at {email} with a quote or our questions.
